title: Test fixtures still mint fd00:: node addresses (routing_gpsr, routing_fwd_buffer, rpl_dao_auth make_ula helpers)
description: Cosmetic residue found by edge-case codereview of zt3c.7.4. lichen/tests/routing_gpsr/src/main.c:31 make_ula(), lichen/tests/routing_fwd_buffer/src/main.c:32, lichen/tests/rpl_dao_auth/src/main.c:69 address() still name/mint fd00:: node addresses. The addresses are identity-opaque in those tests (all 41 twister cases passed in round zt3c.7.5 with them), so this is naming/doc alignment with the fd00-dropped convention (cf. rpl_dodag/main.c:501 where fd00 is now documented as the foreign-mesh probe). Rename helpers + update comments; no behavioral expectation.
